SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Clem.]
Pustular conjunctivitis, complicated with tinea capitis ; with agglutination of lids in morning.
Eyes inflamed, protruded, dim ; eyelids badly ulcerated and secreting acrid water. θ Syphilis.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Clem.]
Swelling of glands in both inguinal regions, with sensitiveness while walking ; right inguinal glands become more swollen, with prickling pain in them, < by walking and in bed ; afterwards a tensive sensation in them, especially when walking.
Swelling of right inguinal gland, < than left, not painful when rising after walking.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Clem.]
Involuntary flow, by drops, after micturition.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Clem.]
Right spermatic cord sensitive, testicles drawn up.
Painful, inflamed and swollen testicles.
Induration of testicles.
Swelling of right half of scrotum, which is thickened and hangs low down ; testicle also relaxed and hanging down.
